# 商品详情页

户外用品网店的商品详情页，是轻盈的店铺风格而不是后台：随所选颜色变化的大幅商品图，名称与价格用展示级字号，更大的圆角与安静的画布。精简的店铺顶栏带购物车按钮，Breadcrumb，点击打开 Lightbox 的图集，自己实现的颜色色块与尺码选择（支持方向键的单选组），数量用 InputNumber 并附库存提示；“加入购物车”先显示 `loading`，再打开装着购物车的 Drawer：改数量、可撤销的移除、包邮进度 Progress 与结算。下方是大号数字的亮点、详情 / 保养 / 配送的 Tabs、可按星级筛选列表的评分分布与评价，以及一排相关商品。

**难度**：场景　**用到的组件**：[Avatar](../components/Avatar.md), [Box](../components/Box.md), [Breadcrumb](../components/Breadcrumb.md), [Button](../components/Button.md), [CountBadge](../components/CountBadge.md), [Descriptions](../components/Descriptions.md), [Drawer](../components/Drawer.md), [EmptyState](../components/EmptyState.md), [Icon](../components/Icon.md), [IconButton](../components/IconButton.md), [Inline](../components/Inline.md), [Input](../components/Input.md), [InputNumber](../components/InputNumber.md), [Lightbox](../components/Lightbox.md), [LinkButton](../components/LinkButton.md), [Panel](../components/Panel.md), [Pill](../components/Pill.md), [Progress](../components/Progress.md), [Segmented](../components/Segmented.md), [Spacer](../components/Spacer.md), [Stack](../components/Stack.md), [StatusDot](../components/StatusDot.md), [Tabs](../components/Tabs.md), [Text](../components/Text.md), [useMessage](../components/useMessage.md)

```tsx
interface CartLine {
  readonly id: string
  readonly name: string
  readonly variant: string

}

  maximumFractionDigits: 0,
})

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms))

const STAR = 'M12 2l3.1 6.3 6.9 1-5 4.9 1.2 6.8L12 17.8 5.8 21l1.2-6.8-5-4.9 6.9-1z'

const HALF_STAR = 'M12 2L8.9 8.3 2 9.3l5 4.9L5.8 21 12 17.8z'

function Stars(props: { readonly value: number; readonly size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' }) {
  const { value, size = 'md' } = props
  return (
    <span
      className={styles.stars}
      data-size={size}
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${value} out of 5 stars`}
    >
      {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((n) => {
        const fill = value >= n - 0.25 ? STAR : value >= n - 0.75 ? HALF_STAR : null
        return (
          <svg key={n} viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <path className={styles.starTrack} d={STAR} />
            {fill && <path className={styles.starFill} d={fill} />}
          </svg>
        )
      })}
    </span>
  )
}

function onRadioKeys<T>(
  e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>,
  list: readonly T[],
  current: T,
  select: (v: T) => void,
) {
  const step = { ArrowRight: 1, ArrowDown: 1, ArrowLeft: -1, ArrowUp: -1 }[e.key]
  if (!step) return
  e.preventDefault()
  select(list[(list.indexOf(current) + step + list.length) % list.length] as T)
  const group = e.currentTarget
  requestAnimationFrame(() => group.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[aria-checked="true"]')?.focus())
}

export function ProductPage() {
  const message = useMessage()
  const [variant, setVariant] = useState<Variant>(VARIANTS[0] as Variant)
  const [size, setSize] = useState<SizeId>('S/M')
  const [qty, setQty] = useState(1)
  const [view, setView] = useState(0)
  const [viewerOpen, setViewerOpen] = useState(false)
  const [adding, setAdding] = useState(false)
  const [cartOpen, setCartOpen] = useState(false)
  const [checkingOut, setCheckingOut] = useState(false)
  const [cart, setCart] = useState<readonly CartLine[]>([
    {
      id: 'bottle',
      name: 'Trail Bottle 750 ml',
      variant: 'Glacier',
      price: 24,
      qty: 1,
      max: 10,
      src: RELATED[0]?.src ?? '',
    },
  ])
  const [starFilter, setStarFilter] = useState<number | null>(null)
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<'helpful' | 'newest'>('helpful')
  const [helpful, setHelpful] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set())

  const photos = VIEWS.map((v) => ({
    id: `${variant.id}-${v}`,
    src: ART[v](variant.shades),
    alt: `${PRODUCT.name} in ${variant.name}, ${v.toLowerCase()}`,
  }))
  const stock = variant.stock[size]
  const quantity = Math.min(qty, Math.max(stock, 1))
  const count = cart.reduce((n, l) => n + l.qty, 0)
  const subtotal = cart.reduce((n, l) => n + l.price * l.qty, 0)
  const toFree = FREE_SHIPPING - subtotal
  const stockNote =
    stock === 0
      ? ({ tone: 'danger', text: `Sold out in ${variant.name}, ${size}` } as const)
      : stock <= 5
        ? ({ tone: 'warning', text: `Only ${stock} left, order soon` } as const)
        : ({ tone: 'success', text: 'In stock, ships in 1 to 2 business days' } as const)
  const reviews = REVIEWS.filter((r) => starFilter === null || r.rating === starFilter).sort(
    (a, b) => (sort === 'newest' ? b.date.localeCompare(a.date) : b.helpful - a.helpful),
  )

  // A real store navigates here, with the router of the application
  const open = (what: string) => message.info(`Open ${what} here`)

  /** Adds a line, or more of a line that is already in the cart. */
  const putInCart = (line: CartLine) =>
    setCart((lines) =>
      lines.some((l) => l.id === line.id)
        ? lines.map((l) =>
            l.id === line.id ? { ...l, qty: Math.min(l.max, l.qty + line.qty) } : l,
          )
        : [...lines, line],
    )

  async function addToCart() {
    setAdding(true)
    await wait(800) // the request to the cart API
    putInCart({
      id: `pack-${variant.id}-${size}`,
      name: PRODUCT.name,
      variant: `${variant.name}, ${size}`,
      price: PRODUCT.price,
      qty: quantity,
      max: stock,
      src: ART.Front(variant.shades),
    })
    setAdding(false)
    setCartOpen(true)
  }

  function remove(line: CartLine) {
    const at = cart.indexOf(line)
    setCart((lines) => lines.filter((l) => l.id !== line.id))
    message.undoable({
      content: `Removed ${line.name}`,
      onUndo: () => setCart((lines) => [...lines.slice(0, at), line, ...lines.slice(at)]),
    })
  }

  async function checkout() {
    setCheckingOut(true)
    await wait(900)
    setCheckingOut(false)
    setCartOpen(false)
    message.success('Checkout opens here')
  }

  return (
    <div className={styles.store} data-variant={variant.id}>
      <p className={styles.promo}>Free shipping over ${FREE_SHIPPING} and free 60-day returns</p>

      <header className={styles.bar}>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.logo}
          data-vl-state=""
          onClick={() => open('the home page')}
        >
          <span className={styles.logoMark} aria-hidden="true" />
          Fieldnote
        </button>
        <nav className={styles.cats} aria-label="Categories">
          {['Packs', 'Apparel', 'Camp', 'Hydration', 'Sale'].map((c) => (
            <button
              key={c}
              type="button"
              className={styles.cat}
              data-vl-state=""
              aria-current={c === 'Packs' ? 'page' : undefined}
              onClick={() => open(c)}
            >
              {c}
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <div className={styles.search}>
          <Input.Search
            placeholder="Search the store"
            aria-label="Search the store"
            onSearch={(q) => q && open(`the results for "${q}"`)}
          />
        </div>
        {/* The icon set has no bag, so the cart draws one with the stroke of the other icons */}
        <button
          type="button"
          className={styles.cart}
          data-vl-state=""
          aria-label={`Cart, ${count} items`}
          onClick={() => setCartOpen(true)}
        >
          <svg className={styles.bag} viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M5 8h14l-1 12H6zM9 8V6a3 3 0 0 1 6 0v2" />
          </svg>
          <span className={styles.cartCount}>
            <CountBadge count={count} tone="accent" />
          </span>
        </button>
      </header>

      <Breadcrumb
        items={[
          { title: 'Home', onClick: () => open('the home page') },
          { title: 'Packs', onClick: () => open('Packs') },
          { title: 'Daypacks', onClick: () => open('Daypacks') },
          { title: PRODUCT.name },
        ]}
      />

      <div className={styles.hero}>
        <section className={styles.gallery} aria-label="Photos">
          <div className={styles.stage}>
            <button
              type="button"
              className={styles.main}
              data-vl-state=""
              aria-label={`Enlarge: ${photos[view]?.alt}`}
              onClick={() => setViewerOpen(true)}
            >
              <img src={photos[view]?.src} alt="" />
            </button>
            <span className={styles.badge}>
              <Pill tone="accent">New color: Clay</Pill>
            </span>
            <span className={styles.zoomHint} aria-hidden="true">
              <Icon name="scan-search" size={14} /> Click to enlarge
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className={styles.thumbs}>
            {photos.map((p, i) => (
              <button
                key={p.id}

                onClick={() => setView(i)}
              >

            ))}
          </div>
        </section>

        <div className={styles.buy}>

          <div className={styles.priceRow}>

              {dollars.format(PRODUCT.was)}

            <Pill tone="danger">Save {Math.round((1 - PRODUCT.price / PRODUCT.was) * 100)}%</Pill>
          </div>
          <Text as="p" tone="secondary">
            A weatherproof everyday pack with a padded laptop sleeve, a quick-access lid pocket and
            a breathable back panel. The commute on weekdays, the ridge on weekends.
          </Text>

          <Stack gap={3}>
            <Text weight="semibold" id="color-label">

            </Text>
            <div
              className={styles.choices}
              role="radiogroup"

              onKeyDown={(e) => onRadioKeys(e, VARIANTS, variant, setVariant)}
            >
              {VARIANTS.map((v) => (
                // biome-ignore lint/a11y/useSemanticElements: a swatch shows an image; the radio role keeps its group semantics
                <button
                  key={v.id}
                  type="button"
                  role="radio"
                  aria-checked={v.id === variant.id}
                  aria-label={v.name}
                  tabIndex={v.id === variant.id ? 0 : -1}
                  className={styles.swatch}
                  data-vl-state=""
                  onClick={() => setVariant(v)}
                >
                  <img src={swatchArt(v.shades)} alt="" />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Stack>

          <Stack gap={3}>
            <Text weight="semibold" id="size-label">
              Size <span className={styles.chosen}>Fits a {TORSO[size]}</span>
            </Text>
            <div
              className={styles.choices}
              role="radiogroup"
              aria-labelledby="size-label"
              onKeyDown={(e) => onRadioKeys(e, SIZES, size, setSize)}
            >
              {SIZES.map((s) => (
                // biome-ignore lint/a11y/useSemanticElements: a pill-shaped choice; the radio role keeps its group semantics
                <button
                  key={s}
                  type="button"
                  role="radio"
                  aria-checked={s === size}
                  aria-label={variant.stock[s] === 0 ? `${s}, sold out` : s}
                  tabIndex={s === size ? 0 : -1}
                  className={styles.size}
                  data-vl-state=""
                  data-soldout={variant.stock[s] === 0 || undefined}
                  onClick={() => setSize(s)}
                >
                  {s}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </Stack>

          <div className={styles.purchase}>
            <InputNumber
              size="lg"
              min={1}
              max={Math.max(stock, 1)}
              value={quantity}
              onChange={(n) => setQty(n ?? 1)}
              disabled={stock === 0}
              aria-label="Quantity"
            />
            <Button
              variant="primary"
              size="lg"
              block
              loading={adding}
              disabled={stock === 0}
              disabledReason="Choose another size or color"
              onClick={addToCart}
            >
              {adding ? 'Adding' : `Add to cart, ${dollars.format(PRODUCT.price * quantity)}`}
            </Button>
          </div>
          <Inline gap={2}>
            <StatusDot tone={stockNote.tone} />
            <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
              {stockNote.text}
            </Text>
          </Inline>

          <Box surface="sunken" radius="xl" padding={4}>
            <Stack gap={3}>
              {PERKS.map((p) => (
                <Inline key={p.title} gap={3}>
                  <Icon name={p.icon} size={18} tone="secondary" />
                  <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
                    {p.title}
                  </Text>
                  <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
                    {p.hint}
                  </Text>
                </Inline>
              ))}
            </Stack>
          </Box>
        </div>
      </div>

      <section className={styles.highlights} aria-label="Highlights">
        {HIGHLIGHTS.map((h) => (
          <Stack key={h.figure} gap={2}>
            <span className={styles.figure}>{h.figure}</span>
            <Text tone="secondary">{h.text}</Text>
          </Stack>
        ))}
      </section>

      <section className={styles.split}>
        <div className={styles.side}>
          <h2 className={styles.title} data-size="lg">
            Made for the in-between days
          </h2>
          <Text as="p" tone="secondary">
            Too much for a tote, not enough for a trekking pack. Structured enough to carry a
            laptop, soft enough to squash under a train seat.
          </Text>
        </div>
        <div className={styles.wide}>
          <Tabs
            items={[
              {
                key: 'details',
                label: 'Details',
                children: (
                  <Descriptions
                    column={2}
                    items={[
                      { label: 'Volume', children: '22 liters' },
                      { label: 'Weight', children: '840 g' },
                      { label: 'Dimensions', children: '48 x 29 x 18 cm' },
                      { label: 'Laptop sleeve', children: 'Up to 16 inch' },
                      {
                        label: 'Sizes',
                        children: SIZES.map((s) => `${s}: ${TORSO[s]}`).join('; '),
                      },
                      { label: 'Pockets', children: 'Lid, front, two side, sleeve' },
                    ]}
                  />
                ),
              },
              {
                key: 'care',
                label: 'Materials and care',
                children: (
                  <Stack gap={2}>
                    <Text as="p">
                      Shell: 210D recycled nylon ripstop with a PFC-free waterproof finish. Lining:
                      recycled polyester. Back panel: open-cell foam under air mesh.
                    </Text>
                    <Text as="p" tone="secondary">
                      Brush off dirt when dry, spot clean with mild soap and cold water, and hang to
                      dry away from heat. Do not machine wash.
                    </Text>
                  </Stack>
                ),
              },
              {
                key: 'shipping',
                label: 'Shipping and returns',
                children: (
                  <Stack gap={2}>
                    <Text as="p">
                      Free standard shipping over ${FREE_SHIPPING}, in 3 to 5 business days; express
                      in 1 to 2 business days for $12.
                    </Text>
                    <Text as="p" tone="secondary">
                      Return anything within 60 days, used or not: print a free label from your
                      order page, or drop it off at one of our stores.
                    </Text>
                  </Stack>
                ),
              },
            ]}
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className={styles.split} id="reviews" aria-labelledby="reviews-title">
        <div className={styles.side}>
          <h2 className={styles.title} id="reviews-title">
            Reviews
          </h2>
          <Inline gap={4}>
            <span className={styles.figure}>{PRODUCT.rating}</span>
            <Stack gap={1}>
              <Stars value={PRODUCT.rating} size="lg" />
              <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
                Based on {PRODUCT.reviews} reviews
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </Inline>
          {/* Each row is a button that filters the list; Progress draws the share of the reviews */}
          <div className={styles.bars}>
            {DISTRIBUTION.map(({ stars, n }) => (
              <button
                key={stars}
                type="button"
                className={styles.barRow}
                data-vl-state=""
                aria-pressed={starFilter === stars}
                aria-label={`${stars} stars: ${n} reviews`}
                onClick={() => setStarFilter(starFilter === stars ? null : stars)}
              >
                <Text size="sm" numeric>
                  {stars}
                </Text>
                <Icon name="star" size={12} tone="tertiary" />
                <Progress
                  percent={(n / PRODUCT.reviews) * 100}
                  size="sm"
                  showValue={false}
                  aria-label={`${stars} stars`}
                />
                <Text size="sm" tone="secondary" numeric>
                  {n}
                </Text>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <Inline>
            <Button icon="edit" onClick={() => open('the review form')}>
              Write a review
            </Button>
          </Inline>
        </div>

        <div className={styles.wide}>
          <Stack gap={4}>
            <Inline gap={2} wrap>
              <Text tone="secondary">
                {starFilter === null ? 'All reviews' : `${starFilter}-star reviews`}
              </Text>
              {starFilter !== null && (
                <LinkButton onClick={() => setStarFilter(null)}>Show all</LinkButton>
              )}
              <Spacer />
              <Segmented
                size="sm"
                aria-label="Sort reviews"
                value={sort}
                onChange={setSort}
                options={[
                  { value: 'helpful', label: 'Most helpful' },
                  { value: 'newest', label: 'Newest' },
                ]}
              />
            </Inline>
            {reviews.length === 0 && (
              <EmptyState
                size="sm"
                icon="star"
                title={`No ${starFilter}-star reviews on this page`}
                description="Your API returns the other pages."
              />
            )}
            {reviews.map((r) => {
              const marked = helpful.has(r.id)
              const toggle = () =>
                setHelpful((s) =>
                  marked ? new Set([...s].filter((id) => id !== r.id)) : new Set(s).add(r.id),
                )
              return (
                <Panel key={r.id} padding={5}>
                  <Stack gap={3}>
                    <Inline gap={3} wrap>
                      <Avatar name={r.name} size={36} />
                      <Stack gap={0}>
                        <Text weight="semibold">{r.name}</Text>
                        <Text size="xs" tone="secondary">
                          Bought {r.bought}
                        </Text>
                      </Stack>
                      <Spacer />
                      <Pill tone="success" icon="check">
                        Verified buyer
                      </Pill>
                    </Inline>
                    <Inline gap={2}>
                      <Stars value={r.rating} size="sm" />
                      <Text size="sm" tone="tertiary" as="time" dateTime={r.date}>
                        {longDate.format(new Date(r.date))}
                      </Text>
                    </Inline>
                    <h3 className={styles.reviewTitle}>{r.title}</h3>
                    <Text as="p" tone="secondary">
                      {r.body}
                    </Text>
                    <Inline>
                      <Button
                        size="sm"
                        variant="text"
                        icon="thumbs-up"
                        aria-pressed={marked}
                        onClick={toggle}
                      >
                        Helpful ({r.helpful + (marked ? 1 : 0)})
                      </Button>
                    </Inline>
                  </Stack>
                </Panel>
              )
            })}
          </Stack>
        </div>
      </section>

      <section className={styles.related} aria-labelledby="related-title">
        <h2 className={styles.title} id="related-title">
          You may also like
        </h2>
        <div className={styles.shelf}>
          {RELATED.map((p) => (
            <article key={p.id} className={styles.card}>
              <button
                type="button"
                className={styles.cardLink}
                data-vl-state=""
                onClick={() => open(p.name)}
              >
                <img src={p.src} alt="" />
                <Text weight="semibold">{p.name}</Text>
                <Text tone="secondary" size="sm">
                  {p.colors} colors
                </Text>
                <span className={styles.cardPrice}>{dollars.format(p.price)}</span>
              </button>
              <span className={styles.quickAdd}>
                <IconButton
                  icon="plus"
                  variant="soft"
                  label={`Add ${p.name} to cart`}
                  onClick={() => {
                    putInCart({ ...p, variant: 'Default color', qty: 1, max: 10 })
                    message.success(`Added ${p.name} to your cart`)
                  }}
                />
              </span>
            </article>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>

      <Lightbox
        open={viewerOpen}
        items={photos}
        index={view}
        onIndexChange={setView}
        onClose={() => setViewerOpen(false)}
      />

      <Drawer
        open={cartOpen}
        onClose={() => setCartOpen(false)}
        title={`Your cart (${count})`}
        width={420}
        footer={
          cart.length > 0 && (
            <Stack gap={3} grow>
              <Inline justify="between">
                <Text weight="semibold">Subtotal</Text>
                <span className={styles.subtotal}>{money.format(subtotal)}</span>
              </Inline>
              <Text size="xs" tone="secondary">
                Taxes and shipping are calculated at checkout.
              </Text>
              <Button variant="primary" size="lg" block loading={checkingOut} onClick={checkout}>
                Check out
              </Button>
            </Stack>
          )
        }
      >
        {cart.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            fill
            icon="package"
            title="Your cart is empty"
            description="Packs, layers and camp gear land here."
            action={<Button onClick={() => setCartOpen(false)}>Keep shopping</Button>}
          />
        ) : (
          <Stack gap={5}>
            <Box surface="sunken" radius="xl" padding={4}>
              <Stack gap={2}>
                <Text size="sm">
                  {toFree > 0
                    ? `You are ${money.format(toFree)} away from free shipping`
                    : 'Your order ships for free'}
                </Text>
                <Progress
                  percent={(subtotal / FREE_SHIPPING) * 100}
                  size="sm"
                  showValue={false}
                  tone={toFree > 0 ? 'accent' : 'success'}
                  aria-label="Free shipping"
                />
              </Stack>
            </Box>
            <Stack as="ul" gap={4}>
              {cart.map((l) => (
                <Inline as="li" key={l.id} align="start" gap={3}>
                  <img src={l.src} alt="" className={styles.lineArt} />
                  <Stack gap={2} grow>
                    <Inline align="start" gap={2}>
                      <Stack gap={0} grow>
                        <Text weight="semibold">{l.name}</Text>
                        <Text size="sm" tone="secondary">
                          {l.variant}
                        </Text>
                      </Stack>
                      <IconButton
                        icon="trash"
                        size="sm"
                        label={`Remove ${l.name}`}
                        onClick={() => remove(l)}
                      />
                    </Inline>
                    <Inline justify="between">
                      <InputNumber
                        size="sm"
                        min={1}
                        max={l.max}
                        value={l.qty}
                        aria-label={`Quantity of ${l.name}`}
                        onChange={(n) =>
                          setCart((lines) =>
                            lines.map((x) => (x.id === l.id ? { ...x, qty: n ?? 1 } : x)),
                          )
                        }
                      />
                      <Text weight="semibold" numeric>
                        {money.format(l.price * l.qty)}
                      </Text>
                    </Inline>
                  </Stack>
                </Inline>
              ))}
            </Stack>
          </Stack>
        )}
      </Drawer>
    </div>
  )
}
```

`ProductPage.module.css`

```css
/*
 * Product page: the look of a storefront. Every value is a token (var(--vl-...)), a relative unit or 0 / 1px, so
 * the page follows the color mode, the accent color and the density with no extra rule. Hover, press and focus
 * come from the shared state layer (data-vl-state); ::before is left to the library.
 *
 * What makes it a store rather than an admin tool: the largest type steps for the name, the price and the
 * figures, the largest radius for photos, wide gaps and almost no lines. Tints use color-mix(in oklab, ...):
 * neutral tokens have no real hue, and oklch would pull the mix towards hue 0.
 */

.store {
  /* The ring of the chosen swatch or photo: 2px wide, inside a 4px padding around the image */
  --ring-width: calc(var(--vl-space-1) / 2);
  --ring-gap: var(--vl-space-1);

  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-6);
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--vl-page-width-default);
  margin-inline: auto;
  /* biome-ignore lint/correctness/noUnknownFunction: global() references keyframes outside the CSS Module */
  animation: global(vl-rise) var(--vl-motion-duration-slow) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard) both;
}

/*
 * The chosen color of the pack tints the promo strip and the highlights: the markup sets data-variant, and the
 * chart color closest to it becomes --variant-tint, so the tint stays a token in both modes.
 */
.store[data-variant="moss"] {
  --variant-tint: var(--vl-color-chart-6);
}
.store[data-variant="clay"] {
  --variant-tint: var(--vl-color-chart-2);
}
.store[data-variant="slate"] {
  --variant-tint: var(--vl-color-chart-1);
}
.store[data-variant="sand"] {
  --variant-tint: var(--vl-color-chart-4);
}

.promo,
.highlights {
  transition: background var(--vl-motion-duration-base) var(--vl-motion-ease-standard);
}

/* —— Store header: a slim white bar with the logo, the categories, the search and the cart —— */

.promo {
  margin: 0 0 calc(var(--vl-space-3) * -1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-4);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--variant-tint) 10%, transparent);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  text-align: center;
}

.bar {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-5);
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-3);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-2xl);
  background: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--vl-shadow-near);
}

/* Every clickable element of our own is a native button, reset here */
.logo,
.cat,
.cart,
.main,
.thumb,
.swatch,
.size,
.barRow,
.cardLink {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: start;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.logo {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) var(--vl-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-md);
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-heading);
  letter-spacing: var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading);
}

/* The mark: a ridge cut out of a block of the text color */
.logoMark {
  width: 1.2em;
  height: 0.8em;
  background: currentColor;
  clip-path: polygon(0 100%, 34% 22%, 52% 58%, 72% 0, 100% 100%);
}

.cats {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
}

.cat {
  padding: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-3);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
}

.cat[aria-current="page"] {
  background: var(--vl-color-fill);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
}

.search {
  flex: 0 1 var(--vl-grid-column-md);
  min-width: var(--vl-grid-column-sm);
}

/* The bag stays at the end of the header, also when search and bag wrap onto a row of their own */
.cart {
  margin-inline-start: auto;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  width: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
}

/* The bag takes the size and stroke of the line icons */
.bag {
  width: var(--vl-font-size-2xl);
  height: var(--vl-font-size-2xl);
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.6;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
}

.cartCount {
  position: absolute;
  inset-block-start: 0;
  inset-inline-end: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* —— Gallery and buy box: two columns, the box wraps below once the gallery would get too small —— */

.hero,
.split {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: var(--vl-space-6) var(--vl-space-7);
}

.gallery {
  display: flex;
  flex: 7 1 calc(var(--vl-grid-column-lg) * 1.4);
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
  min-width: 0;
}

.stage {
  position: relative;
}

.main {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-2xl);
  cursor: zoom-in;
}

.main img,
.thumb img,
.cardLink img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: inherit;
}

.badge {
  position: absolute;
  inset: var(--vl-space-4) auto auto var(--vl-space-4);
}

/* Text over a photo takes the viewer tokens, which stay readable on any image in both modes */
.zoomHint {
  position: absolute;
  inset: auto var(--vl-space-4) var(--vl-space-4) auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) var(--vl-space-3);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-viewer-control-bg);
  color: var(--vl-viewer-text);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xs);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.thumbs {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, calc(var(--vl-space-8) * 1.5)));
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}

/*
 * Thumbnails and swatches: the image sits in a padding of --ring-gap, and the chosen one gets an inset ring of
 * the text color in that padding. The ring is a shadow, so the focus outline of data-vl-state stays free.
 */
.thumb,
.swatch {
  padding: var(--ring-gap);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-xl);
}

.thumb img {
  border-radius: calc(var(--vl-radius-xl) - var(--ring-gap));
}

.thumb[aria-pressed="true"],
.swatch[aria-checked="true"] {
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--ring-width) var(--vl-color-text-primary);
}

.buy {
  display: flex;
  flex: 5 1 var(--vl-grid-column-lg);
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-5);
  min-width: 0;
  /* Stays in view next to the tall gallery while the page scrolls */
  position: sticky;
  inset-block-start: 0;
}

/* Display type: the largest steps of the scale, set a little tighter than headings */
.name,
.price,
.figure,
.title {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  font-family: var(--vl-font-family-heading);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-4xl);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-heading);
  line-height: var(--vl-line-height-heading);
  letter-spacing: calc(var(--vl-letter-spacing-heading) * 2);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  text-wrap: balance;
}

.price,
.title[data-size="lg"] {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-3xl);
}

.title {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-2xl);
}

.priceRow,
.choices {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2) var(--vl-space-3);
}

.was {
  color: var(--vl-color-text-tertiary);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
}

/* Read by screen readers only ("Was $159") */
.hidden {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.chosen {
  margin-inline-start: var(--vl-space-2);
  color: var(--vl-color-text-secondary);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-regular);
}

.swatch {
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
}

/* A hairline keeps the light Sand chip visible on a white surface */
.swatch img {
  display: block;
  width: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  outline: 1px solid var(--vl-color-border-strong);
  outline-offset: -1px;
}

/* Sizes are pills; the chosen one is inverted, in the text color */
.size {
  min-width: calc(var(--vl-control-height-lg) * 2);
  height: var(--vl-control-height-lg);
  padding-inline: var(--vl-space-4);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-full);
  background: var(--vl-color-fill);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-medium);
  text-align: center;
}

.size[aria-checked="true"] {
  background: var(--vl-color-text-primary);
  color: var(--vl-color-bg-surface);
}

.size[data-soldout] {
  text-decoration: line-through;
  opacity: 0.6;
}

.purchase {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: var(--vl-space-3);
}

/* —— Highlights: three large figures on a wash of the chosen color —— */

.highlights {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(var(--vl-grid-column-md), 100%), 1fr));
  gap: var(--vl-space-6);
  padding: var(--vl-space-7) var(--vl-space-6);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-2xl);
  background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--variant-tint) 9%, var(--vl-color-bg-surface));
}

/* The figures take the tint moved towards the text color, readable in both modes */
.highlights .figure {
  color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--variant-tint) 65%, var(--vl-color-text-primary));
}

/* —— About and reviews: a narrow side column next to a wide one —— */

.side {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1 1 var(--vl-grid-column-lg);
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
}

.wide {
  flex: 2 1 calc(var(--vl-grid-column-lg) * 1.5);
  min-width: 0;
}

.bars {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-inline: calc(var(--vl-space-2) * -1);
}

/* One row per star count: the count, a star, the share and the number; a button that filters the list */
.barRow {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1ch auto 1fr 4ch;
  align-items: center;
  gap: var(--vl-space-2);
  padding: var(--vl-space-1) var(--vl-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-md);
  text-align: end;
}

.barRow[aria-pressed="true"] {
  background: var(--vl-color-fill-selected);
}

.reviewTitle {
  margin: 0;
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
}

/* —— Related products: borderless cards, the photo is the card —— */

.related {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-4);
  padding-bottom: var(--vl-space-6);
}

/* auto-fit stretches the four cards across the row and wraps them on narrow screens */
.shelf {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(
      auto-fit,
      minmax(min(calc(var(--vl-grid-column-sm) * 1.25), 100%), 1fr)
    );
  gap: var(--vl-space-5);
}

.card {
  position: relative;
  min-width: 0;
}

.cardLink {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: var(--vl-space-1);
  width: 100%;
  padding-bottom: var(--vl-space-2);
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-2xl);
}

.cardLink img {
  margin-bottom: var(--vl-space-2);
}

.cardPrice,
.subtotal {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
  font-weight: var(--vl-font-weight-semibold);
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
}

.quickAdd {
  position: absolute;
  inset: var(--vl-space-3) var(--vl-space-3) auto auto;
}

/* —— Stars: a track of the strong fill, filled with the amber of the chart palette —— */

.stars {
  display: inline-flex;
  gap: calc(var(--vl-space-1) / 4);
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-lg);
}

.stars[data-size="sm"] {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-md);
}

.stars[data-size="lg"] {
  font-size: var(--vl-font-size-xl);
}

.stars svg {
  display: block;
  width: 1em;
  height: 1em;
}

.starTrack {
  fill: var(--vl-color-fill-strong);
}

.starFill {
  fill: var(--vl-color-chart-4);
}

/* —— Cart drawer —— */

.lineArt {
  flex: none;
  width: calc(var(--vl-space-8) * 1.25);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  border-radius: var(--vl-radius-lg);
}
```
